fields.name: code
fields.label: %code%
fields.help: Other plugins ask for numbers by this code, such as invoice or hr_employee.

fields.name: prefix
fields.label: %prefix%
fields.help: Text before the number. {YYYY} {YY} {MM} {DD} are replaced by the date of the document.

fields.name: padding
fields.label: %padding%
fields.help: Digits the counter is padded to with zeros (0 to 12).

fields.name: reset
fields.label: %reset%
fields.help: never, year or month: the counter starts again in each year or month, counted by the document date.

fields.name: scope
fields.label: %scope%
fields.help: Optional owner such as a company id; the same code can be a separate sequence per scope.

fields.name: gapless
fields.label: %gapless%
fields.help: Every number issued is recorded, so a hole can be found and must be explained by voiding it.

fields.name: key
fields.label: %key%
fields.help: code and scope together; set by the plugin.
